news.title: One-Shot Mobs On Your Alts With Legacy Points in WoW Forever
news.description: Players in WoW Forever know about the Legacy Point system, but most are unaware of how easy it is to get player power early on.

news.title: Hourly Dungeon Reset Limit Halved, Class Fixes, Quest Improvements: WoW Forever Hotfixes, November 20th
news.description: We have some big changes in this week's final hotfixes, with much fewer dungeon resets, Rogue and Warlock fixes, and more.

news.title: Skyborne Players Are Getting 10% Off Mounts in WoW Forever Without Honored
news.description: Skyborne players get the 10% mount discount at Friendly after the latest hotfix. Early buyers have no word on refunds yet.

news.title: A Secret Cave With A Familiar Mini Boss Has Been Found In WoW Forever
news.description: Players have discovered a new secret mini-boss in a cave in Arathi Highlands in World of Warcraft Forever!

news.title: Camping, Races, Quest Improvements: WoW Forever Hotfixes, November 19th
news.description: Another batch of hotfixes is here, this time bringing back the Seed Hybridizer and improving it, some class, dungeon, quest fixes, and more.

news.title: WoW Forever Pre-Raid DPS Tier List Now Live
news.description: Time to check the pre-raid tier list for DPS classes, as our guide writers rank all the specs, and a familiar Classic face comes out on top.

news.title: These WoW Forever Boots Let You Walk on Water, and 250 Players Can Win Them
news.description: The Surfer Shoes give you 5 minutes of water walking. Catch 40 Speckled Tastyfish during Sunday’s Stranglethorn Extravaganza to get them.

news.title: Sealed Writs Are a Daily Source of Supply Faction Reputation in WoW Forever
news.description: Sealed Writs drop from chests and level 10+ mobs, each starting a daily quest worth up to 200 Supply Faction reputation. No profession needed.
